params.body:
The workbench was one list sorted by state, so a client's sites sat scattered across it. You admit for a client, so the page now groups per client:

- clients alphabetically, our own work (no client) last under "Internal", as on the fleet screen
- within a client the old order holds: the project that asks first, then stale, then the rest
- the heading shows the number of projects and, if any, how many ask

The form, the selection and the passkey flow are unchanged; each group is its own `.list`.

Test: `test_the_page_is_grouped_per_client_with_our_own_work_last`. Workbench tests 10/10, full suite 584/585 (the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which reads the stamp from the checkout and does not find it in a worktree).
params.title: Workbench grouped per client
